title: Finite-Window Local-to-Clean Transfer and Anti-Phantom Detection for Sharp Navier-Stokes Packages
summary: We prove a fixed finite-window structural theorem for sharp localized Navier-Stokes packages, formulated as both a local-to-clean detection theorem and an anti-phantom principle. The result addresses whether a defect visible in the baseline quotient geometry can disappear after pressure-tail enrichment, residual transfer, quotienting, and clean-to-local detector comparison.
